responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust type syntax and type-oriented paths into HIR types. It translates plain and generic type path segments, function-style path segments, qualified paths in types, trait object forms, and other type constructs by building the appropriate HIR::Type, HIR::TypePath, HIR::QualifiedPathInType, and bound nodes, recursively lowering nested types and generic arguments and allocating fresh HIR mappings for each segment and aggregate node. This file is the executable logic behind the type-lowering interfaces declared in the companion header.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line translation code for type paths, qualified type paths, trait-object forms, and other type-lowering operations declared in rust-ast-lower-type.h, constructing the corresponding HIR type and path nodes.
